intent: Revise B1 for clear student budget checking

concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Input image B2-desktop.png is the approved-for-this-edit design target, not an instruction document. Create its carefully responsive mobile reflow for NSEDU Section 5 only, no header, device frame, browser chrome or full landing page. Portrait canvas approximately 840 x 1700. Preserve wine #72243B, taupe #806C60, ivory #FFFAF8, pale rose and greige palette, DM Serif Display editorial headings and Plus Jakarta Sans UI. Desktop design has clear labeled inputs, three cost groups, a visible outcome, a scholarship support strip. Translate this exact content into a real narrow mobile viewport layout, compact and readable rather than shrinking desktop.
Background ivory with one faint corner campus line drawing and a tiny cream notebook/wine pencil vignette at upper right, very restrained under 6% of image, no background behind body text, no large right-hand campus photo. Main content comfortable mobile gutters and adequate tap target sizes.
At top small 'NSEDU / BUDGET CHECK'; heading wrapping naturally 'Can this college fit your budget?'; helper 'See your first-year cost, including living expenses.'
One cohesive white bordered planning surface, all controls stacked, visible labels: 'Your college' dropdown 'Northfield Institute (demo)' plus 'B.Tech · Bengaluru · 2026–27', 'Where will you stay?' dropdown 'College hostel', 'Your first-year budget' currency input '₹4,00,000'. No sliders, save button or whole-course switch.
Immediately after inputs show soft greige result box, FIRST before cost rows: 'Estimated first-year cost' large '₹3,75,000', small 'Includes ₹5,000 refundable deposit'; compact status check '₹25,000 left in your budget', small 'Your budget: ₹4,00,000'; full-width wine button 'Find colleges in my budget' with arrow. Keep primary label readable on one line if comfortable otherwise clean two-line; no giant button.
Then three compact cost rows under small heading 'What makes up the cost?' College fees ₹2,40,000 with helper 'First-year tuition'; Stay & food ₹96,000 helper 'Hostel and meals'; Other costs ₹39,000 helper 'Books, travel and joining charges'. Clear amounts right aligned and icons small. 'View detailed costs' disclosure link with chevron at end; six-item breakdown closed. No chart or percentages.
Below card compact scholarship support area: small icon, 'Need help with the cost?' and 'Explore merit, income and state-based scholarships.' followed by outlined 'Find scholarships' arrow button. Last small readable note 'Sample estimate. Confirm current fees before applying. Scholarships are not included.'
Exact arithmetic240000+96000+39000=375000, budget400000 leftover25000. All examples fictional. Do not introduce awards, charts, testimonials, new content, phone status bars, giant whitespace or crowded tiny text. This is a student-facing practical mobile section, not a marketing poster. Natural vertical page scrolling is appropriate on mobile. Preserve beautiful desktop design language with student controls and result easy to understand.

Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset: NSEDU Section 5 B2 desktop redesign, only this section of a student college discovery landing page. Input image is the edit target B1-desktop.png: preserve its NSEDU brand palette and fictional costs, but substantially redesign the hierarchy for easy student understanding.
Create a crisp, high fidelity frontend design screenshot, wide landscape approximately 1800 x 900. No browser chrome, no header or other page sections. Clean contemporary editorial education UI with precise alignment, comfortably readable labels, restrained borders and generous but compact spacing.
Palette exactly primary wine #72243B, taupe #806C60, ivory #FFFAF8, white, light greige #F1ECE8, pale rose #EED8DC, charcoal #2A2024. DM Serif Display headings, Plus Jakarta Sans body. No blue, glassmorphism, neon, massive blobs or busy patterned background.
BACKGROUND: attractive but very light ivory paper atmosphere. A faint architectural arch contour and delicate campus line drawing behind the far right outer margin, subtle warm daylight wash. A small realistic cream notebook with a wine pencil and two understated coins beside the upper right heading, occupies less than 8% of total canvas and never overlaps text. Tiny unobtrusive paper fold in lower outer corner. Crisp usable white form area stays visually quiet. Background should look designed, not empty, while remaining professional and fast-loading-feeling.
HEADER: small eyebrow 'NSEDU / BUDGET CHECK'. Large short wine heading 'Can this college fit your budget?' Beneath 'See your first-year cost, including living expenses.' Avoid vague financial slogan.
MAIN: a single broad rounded white card, slim taupe border, premium restrained shadow. Top row has THREE clearly labeled controls, arranged horizontally and with sane proportions: 'Your college' dropdown 'Northfield Institute (demo)' with small 'B.Tech · Bengaluru · 2026–27'; 'Where will you stay?' dropdown 'College hostel'; 'Your first-year budget' currency input '₹4,00,000'. Show all relevant first-year context. No sliders, no whole-course toggle, no save-plan button, no hidden assumptions jargon.
Below thin divider, two uneven columns:
LEFT approx 52%: heading 'What makes up the cost?' and three compact neatly aligned icon rows with simple meaningful line icons. Row 1 'College fees' amount '₹2,40,000' and small helper 'Tuition for the first year'. Row 2 'Stay & food' amount '₹96,000' helper 'Hostel and meals'. Row 3 'Other costs' amount '₹39,000' helper 'Books, travel and joining charges'. Amounts align flush right. At bottom one small secondary disclosure link 'View detailed costs' plus down chevron; keep the six-item full breakdown CLOSED. No percentages or competing decorative graphs.
RIGHT approx 43%: an elegant soft greige/ivory result panel with compact small heading 'Estimated first-year cost', very prominent wine '₹3,75,000', then small 'Includes ₹5,000 refundable deposit'. A restrained outlined status line with a check icon and text '₹25,000 left in your budget', and subordinate 'Your budget: ₹4,00,000'. One single very clear wine primary button 'Find colleges in my budget' with arrow. Small helper beneath 'Try another college or edit your budget above.' No loan offers or admission promises.
Directly below the main card a slim low-height funding strip, NOT another big card or side panel: small scholarship graduation-cap icon, left 'Need help with the cost?' and 'Explore merit, income and state-based scholarships.' On right elegant outlined button 'Find scholarships' with arrow. Do not show claimed matched scholarships or award amounts.
Bottom subtle footnote 'Sample estimate. Confirm current fees before applying. Scholarships are not included.'
Exact arithmetic: 240000+96000+39000=375000; budget400000 minus cost375000 =25000. These are fictional illustrative fixtures. No star ratings, irrelevant article cards, six-row expanded worksheet, dense tables, excessive whitespace, duplicated primary actions, invented scholarship eligibility claims, green/red alarm styling, hamburger app dashboard.
Render polished usable student-facing UI, all essential labels and rupee amounts legible. The visual should immediately explain college + stay + budget --> first-year cost + remaining budget, with additional details available on demand.
